_note: MOCK synthesis used only when GEMINI_API_KEY is missing. Values come from PepsiCo's Q3 2026 release (data/raw) and Q2 2026 release (data/prior).

core_eps_growth.what_changed: Core EPS growth cut to +2.5% to +3.5%, from the low end of +5% to +7%. First formal cut this year, after July's low-end warning. Revenue outlook raised to about +6%.
core_eps_growth.why_it_matters: Margins, not demand, are breaking the plan: the top line holds while EPS resets by roughly 2.5 points, so peer staples models need a margin check, not a volume one.

organic_revenue_growth.what_changed: Full-year organic revenue held at about +3%, the midpoint of +2% to +4%; Q3 accelerated to +3.1%.
organic_revenue_growth.why_it_matters: Demand is holding up; the guide-down is a cost story, which is what peers should benchmark against.

net_revenue_growth.what_changed: Reported net revenue growth now about +6%, the top of +4% to +6%; Q3 net revenue was $25.27B, up 5.6%.
net_revenue_growth.why_it_matters: FX and acquisitions lift reported sales, which flatters the top line versus organic growth.

operating_margin.what_changed: Margin performance came in below plan on higher input costs and mix.
operating_margin.why_it_matters: Input-cost inflation and mix are hitting a scaled staples player; expect the same pressure in peers' Q4 margins.

north_america_margin.what_changed: North America margin pressure continues into Q4; pricing tools and cost cuts only partly offset it.
north_america_margin.why_it_matters: The largest profit pool stays under pressure through year-end, so Q4 risk sits in the US business.

outlook_next_year.why_it_matters: With no 2027 anchor, consensus sets the bar; expect wider estimate dispersion into the Q4 print.
